clips.send: Science notes: the ATP numbers in the model are only for comparison. In real cells, pseudopods are pushed out by actin filaments (ATP), vesicles are pinched off by dynamin (GTP), and motor proteins (ATP) carry them inside. Common misconceptions: big particles diffuse through the membrane; vesicles appear from nowhere (they are made from the membrane); endocytosis needs no energy.

clips.send: Amoeba hunt. Steer the amoeba: drag or tap toward the green paramecium. 1. Reach out: The membrane flows out into pseudopods (“false feet”). Moving them uses energy (ATP). 2. Wrap around: The pseudopods wrap around the paramecium like a cupped hand. 3. Pinch off: The tips meet and fuse. A piece of membrane pinches off around the food: now it is inside a vesicle called a food vacuole. 4. Move inside: The vesicle carries the food deeper into the cytoplasm. 5. Lysosome joins: A lysosome fuses with the vesicle and adds digestive enzymes. 6. Digest: The food is broken down. Small nutrient molecules (yellow) pass into the cytoplasm for the cell to use.

clips.send: Catch only cholesterol. Receptors (Y shapes) grab only LDL particles: orange “cholesterol packages” from the blood. Tap outside the cell to add more LDL. 1. Bind: LDL particles stick to their matching receptors, like a key in a lock. 2. Coated pit: When enough receptors are full, a protein coat (clathrin, gray spikes) bends the membrane inward into a pit. 3. Pinch off: The pit pinches off into a coated vesicle carrying only LDL. 4. Uncoat and move in: The coat falls off and the vesicle moves inside. The receptors are recycled back to the membrane. 5. Release: The LDL is broken down and the cholesterol (yellow) is released for the cell to use.

Chase: The white blood cell crawls toward the bacteria, pushing out pseudopods. This uses energy (ATP). 2. Wrap around: The membrane wraps around the bacterium. 3. clips.send: 变形虫捕食。操控变形虫：朝绿色的草履虫拖动或点击。 1。伸出伪足: 细胞膜向外流动，形成伪足（“假的脚”）。伸出伪足要消耗能量，A T P。 2。包围食物: 伪足像握起的手一样，把草履虫包围起来。 3。闭合脱离: 伪足的末端相遇、融合，一小块细胞膜包着食物脱离下来：食物进入了一个囊泡，叫作食物泡。 4。运进细胞: 囊泡把食物运到细胞质的深处。 5。溶酶体融合: 溶酶体与囊泡融合，加入消化酶。 6。消化吸收: 食物被分解，小小的营养分子（黄色）进入细胞质，供细胞利用。
